items.title: Leonard Bocage Interview, 1972-03-24
items.q: So they came around about 10 o'clock, and they sat in. They came around and sat in for a while with us, and they played a couple of numbers, you see.

ctx.x: Because one night, we played at the Corporate's Hall. And when they asked where the trumpet player was, I told him, I said, there he is. So the man said, I hide no cheering down here, you know. So I said, you're already playing. Wait till you start playing. So at that time, I started playing. At 10 o'clock, the hall was cracked down. So he asked me, he said, where you got that boy from? I said, that boy came from across the river. You know, I said, well, let me go out there. I can't be playing some trumpet up…
Which Sam Morgan band was that? Was that the first one or the second one?
